{{Top|leg}}
'''Habitat shells''' were dome-shaped structures that were built on inhospitable [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] and could be filled with breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. These structures allowed individuals to live on the planet, and the shells could be connected with tunnels and passageways.
